name: diapo
description: Diapo, a standalone HTML deck editor. The app has no npm dependencies; this file pulls in Playwright for the tests, Font Awesome Free for tools/build-fa.js and the libraries tools/build-vendor.js copies or bundles (esbuild) into app/vendor/.

scripts.test:py: py -3 -m unittest tests.test_pptx_chart tests.test_pptx_import tests.test_emf_svg tests.test_md_import tests.test_settings tests.test_server_files tests.test_pptx_export tests.test_update_check tests.test_deck_files tests.test_upload_ext tests.test_pptx_scatter tests.test_publish tests.test_looks tests.test_mcp_server tests.test_templates_runtime tests.test_cite_lookup
